# bash completion for jet (generated by `jet completions bash`)
_jet() {
local cur prev cmds flags
COMPREPLY=()
cur="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD]}"
cmds="run check test build new fmt fix explain doctor dev bind add remove fetch update store gc completions man lsp version upgrade help"
flags="--json --color --version --emit-rust --check --small --locked --annotated --verbose --online --fix --dry-run"
if [[ "$cur" == -* ]]; then
COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "$flags" -- "$cur") )
return 0
fi
if [[ $COMP_CWORD -eq 1 ]]; then
COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "$cmds" -- "$cur") )
return 0
fi
COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -f -- "$cur") )
}
complete -F _jet jet
